# shopify_metafield_definition (Data Source)

Reads a metafield definition by owner type, namespace and key. Use it for definitions owned by Shopify (namespace `shopify`) or by an app, which can't be imported into `shopify_metafield_definition`; it works for merchant-owned definitions too. Fails if no such definition exists. Shopify also returns nothing when the app lacks the read scope for the owner type.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A definition owned by Shopify, which can't be imported into a resource.
data "shopify_metafield_definition" "material" {
  owner_type = "PRODUCT"
  namespace  = "shopify"
  key        = "material"
}

output "material_type" {
  value = data.shopify_metafield_definition.material.type
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `key` (String) Key within the namespace.
- `namespace` (String) Namespace, e.g. `shopify`.
- `owner_type` (String) Owner resource type, e.g. `PRODUCT`, `ORDER` or `SHOP`.

### Read-Only

- `access` (Attributes) API access settings. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--access))
- `description` (String) Description. Empty when none is set.
- `id` (String) Metafield definition GID.
- `name` (String) Human-readable name.
- `pin` (Boolean) Whether the definition is pinned in the admin.
- `type` (String) Metafield type, e.g. `number_integer`.
- `use_as_collection_condition` (Boolean) Whether the definition can be used in smart collection conditions.
- `validations` (Map of String) Validation name to value. JSON-shaped values are JSON strings.

<a id="nestedatt--access"></a>
### Nested Schema for `access`

Read-Only:

- `admin` (String) Admin API access. Null when Shopify reports a value that `shopify_metafield_definition` can't set, e.g. the default `PUBLIC_READ_WRITE`.
- `customer_account` (String) Customer account API access.
- `storefront` (String) Storefront API access.
